fields.Name: T173 - Test Explorer Filter Popover And Search
fields.Description: Exercises the explorer's mj-filter-popover (view/status/sort) plus highlightSearch over a card grid — a distinct filter surface, not the generic grid filter/sort.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", and reach the Test Explorer (the card-grid view with a search box, a Filters button, and a card/list view toggle). Type a term into the "Search tests and suites..." box and confirm cards narrow with matched text highlighted (or a no-results empty state appears). Then open the "Filters" popover and change the View (All/Suites/Tests), a Status chip, or the Sort dropdown, and confirm the card grid responds. Success is that search and the filter popover both drive the visible cards. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Test Explorer shows a search box, a Filters popover button, and a card/list view toggle
Typing in the search narrows the cards (matches highlighted) or shows a no-results empty state
Opening the Filters popover and changing View/Status/Sort updates the displayed cards
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
